summary: v62: Admin-editable footer social links + branded fee receipt PDFs. Backend 19/19 pytest pass (public defaults, admin save/persist, whitespace strip, empty hides, 422 for http/javascript/ftp/space/no-scheme, CSRF-missing/anon/vendor rejected, vendor receipt list, own PDF 200 %PDF w/ attachment header, other vendor's 404, missing 404, anon 401, direct render). issue_receipt unit check (send_email mocked): PDF attached (application/pdf, filename PMC-RCPT-xxxxx.pdf), idempotent on session_id, no exceptions. Rendered PDF visually verified: PMC logo header, PAID badge, meta, line table, total. UI: footer icons on / and /contact show API hrefs; admin /admin/e/marketing?tab=links form prefilled, save shows toast, clearing facebook hides icon on home, http:// shows 422 toast; vendor /vendor/emd receipts table shows TEST row and PDF button downloads a valid 51KB PDF.

issues: Total renders 'GBP 49.5' — add minimumFractionDigits: 2 for currency formatting
